title: P6-013 regression: the new fall-back end strips a data byte 0x0D as if it were end-of-line, so a page with no direct /Length whose data ends in 0x0D is dropped (worked before the fix)
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main && npx vitest run --config vitest.p6probe.config.ts tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/reviewer4/pdfimages.probe.test.ts (and pdfimages-old.probe.test.ts for the pre-fix code)
root_cause: When /Length is not trusted, the fix removes the LF before 'endstream' and then, separately, a CR before it, even when the EOL was a lone LF; a stream whose own last byte is 0x0D loses it. Flate then fails its adler-32 (inflate throws, page counted as skipped); an unfiltered bitmap is one byte short of W*H. Affects about 1 in 256 Flate pages whose /Length is indirect or wrong; reached by the Data Studio (src/lib/studio/parse.ts:534, bitmaps on). The petition desk (manu/files.ts:33, JPEG only) is not hit since a JPEG ends FF D9. Removing CR only as part of a CRLF pair has the same flaw; only the EOL the writer added should go, and a lone LF is the whole EOL.

area: Data Studio file parsing (P6-018 fix review)
title: A valid workbook whose table of contents uses zip64 size fields (0xFFFFFFFF + zip64 extra) is refused as 'incomplete or damaged: it may have been cut off', though SheetJS reads all 50 rows
repro: same probe file, test 'a valid workbook with zip64 size fields ...'
root_cause: zipIntact reads csize from the central entry (at+20) and the EOCD fields as 32-bit values and never consults the zip64 extra (0x0001) or zip64 end record, so 0xFFFFFFFF sizes or offsets fail data + csize > cd. Writers that always emit zip64 central fields (some streaming writers) produce such files; frequency in real Excel/LibreOffice/Google output not verified.

area: Ask District IQ writer (P6-019 fix review)
title: Look-alike fence tags still survive unfenced(): a soft hyphen (U+00AD), U+2061, or a Cyrillic а inside "</untrusted_data>" is left as is
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main && npx vitest run --config vitest.p6probe.config.ts tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/reviewer5/polish-fence.test.ts < /dev/null
root_cause: unfenced() drops only U+200B-200D, U+2060, U+FEFF after NFKC; NFKC does not fold a soft hyphen, invisible operators or Cyrillic homoglyphs, and the tag regex needs Latin letters. Whether a model treats these as the fence close is not tested (no model calls); the number check stays the real guard.
